def render(report):
    """Render report to a Markdown table."""
    top_words_str = ", ".join(f"{word} ({count})" for word, count in report["top_words"])

    table = f"""| Statistic | Value |
| - | - |
| Word Count | {report["word_count"]} |
| Distinct Words | {report["distinct_words"]} |
| Top Words | {top_words_str} |"""

    return table
